jobs.title: GIS Analyst (Jr.)
jobs.description:
Performs data collection, analysis, interpretation, and management duties. Prepares presentations that reflect the results of the data analysis. Works with scientists and other technical experts to design and develop statistical analyses methodologies.  
In addition to the above requirements, provides specific analysis and research for Homeland Security mission areas (i.e. critical infrastructure protection, flood risk modeling, law enforcement operations, etc.).  
Prepares assessments of current threats and trends based on the sophisticated collection, research and analysis of classified and open source information.  
Leads technical demonstrations, exchanges, and other technical presentations on materials and analysis generated.  
Provides guidance and work leadership to junior team members.  
Maintains knowledge of both current and emerging technologies, capabilities, best practices to perform a whole range of geospatial analyses.  
Participates in specialized geospatial analytical projects as required.  
  
*Integrity is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is dedicated to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee for employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

jobs.title: Sr. Geospatial Trainer / Outreach Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position: Senior Geospatial Trainer / Outreach Specialist – GeoDES (DHS)**

**Location: Remote from DC, MD, and VA with occasional travel to DHS in DC.**

**Clearance: Must be able to obtain/maintain a Public Trust**

**ASET Partners, an ODRG** **company,** seeks a Senior **Geospatial Trainer / Outreach Specialist** to support federal, state, and local users in discovering and utilizing DHS geospatial data. This remote position is open to candidates based in Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia and requires occasional travel to DHS offices in Washington, D.C.

In this role, you will design, develop, and deliver geospatial training curricula—including instructor-led sessions, virtual workshops, webinars, and self-paced materials—that help DHS components and mission partners discover, access, and use enterprise geospatial data, services, and applications. You will lead stakeholder outreach and engagement, building relationships across DHS components to understand user needs, promote adoption of GeoDES capabilities, gather feedback, and translate it into improved training and support resources. Responsibilities include maintaining user guides, quick-reference materials, and knowledge-base content; tracking training participation and effectiveness; and coordinating closely with the program’s data, development, and solution architecture teams.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in GIS training and user engagement within a federal environment, strong working knowledge of Esri ArcGIS technologies (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online/Enterprise, Experience Builder, and Dashboards), excellent presentation and communication skills, and the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**About the role**

The DHS Geospatial Management Office shares geospatial data with homeland security partners at every level of government through HIFLD Secure and the DHS Geospatial Information Infrastructure (GII). You will assist the outreach team in helping those users get access, learn the data and tools, and stay informed through training, webinars, user events, and clear, accessible materials.

**What you will do**

* Assist with webinars, training sessions, and short training videos on GMO data and tools.
* Assist with answering user questions from the program inbox and helping users get access to HIFLD Secure data.
* Assist with user events such as the HIFLD User Forum, the DHS Geospatial Working Group, and conference booths.
* Assist with presentations, user guides, infographics, and email bulletins, and help keep them Section 508 accessible.
* Assist with user surveys and outreach metrics.

**What you need**

* Bachelor's degree plus 6 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree plus 4 years, or 10 years of relevant experience in place of a degree.
* Experience in training, outreach, or technical communications.
* Comfortable presenting to groups and explaining technical topics in plain language.
* U.S. citizen able to pass a DHS suitability background check.

**Tools in the environment**

ArcGIS Online / ArcGIS Pro / ArcGIS Enterprise, HIFLD Secure, DHS GII portal, GovDelivery, Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Forms), Survey123, Camtasia, Drupal, SharePoint, Jira / Confluence.
